brand_identity.name: Cafe TAB (Take A Break)
brand_identity.mission: To provide a cozy sanctuary for connection, relaxation, and culinary delight in Bihar Sharif.

primary.description: Espresso Brown - Used for Headings, Main Text, Solid Buttons

secondary.description: Deep Forest Green - Nature accents, Secondary buttons

grid_system.bento: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6 auto-rows-[300px]

layout_strategy.alignment: Left-aligned text for readability, asymmetric layouts for visual interest.

variants.primary: bg-[#4E3B31] text-[#FDFBF7] hover:bg-[#3A2C24] transition-all duration-300 rounded-full px-8 py-4 font-semibold shadow-lg hover:scale-105
variants.outline: border-2 border-[#4E3B31] text-[#4E3B31] hover:bg-[#4E3B31] hover:text-[#FDFBF7] transition-all duration-300 rounded-full px-8 py-4 font-semibold
variants.ghost: text-[#4E3B31] hover:bg-[#4E3B31]/10 transition-colors rounded-full px-6 py-3

Card.style: bg-white border border-[#E5E5E5] p-8 rounded-xl transition-all duration-300 hover:border-[#D97706]/50 hover:shadow-hover group

Navigation.style: fixed top-0 left-0 right-0 z-50 bg-[#FDFBF7]/80 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-[#E5E5E5]/50 py-4

home.hero_style: Split screen: Left text (Big Bold Headline) + Right Image (Collage of Interior + Coffee with floating elements)

menu.layout: Categorized List with 'Receipt' visual styling for the container. Use dotted lines between item and price.

gallery.layout: Masonry Layout (Parallax effect on scroll if possible)

contact.layout: Map on one side, clean form on the other. Floating hours card over the map.

animations.scroll_reveal: opacity-0 translate-y-8 transition-all duration-700 ease-out viewport:opacity-100 viewport:translate-y-0

instructions_to_main_agent: Use 'Montserrat' for all headings and 'Lato' for body text. Add these via Google Fonts in index.html or CSS.
Implement the 'Receipt' style for the menu items - it's a key brand differentiator.
Use the Bento Grid layout for the 'Featured Highlights' section on the homepage.
Ensure the 'Contact' form has a success state (mocked) as requested.
For the Map, use an iframe embed for 'Ghagra, Bihar Sharif'.
Use the 'Mustard' accent color sparingly - only for Buttons and key highlights.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES: Do not use generic centered layouts. Use asymmetry.
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical designs (p-12, p-16).
Ensure high contrast for text (APCA standards).
